profile.headline: Software Engineer at City and County of San Francisco

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Engineer working with various stacks/platforms and services:
- apache, php, mysql
- angular, node/express, mongo
- php, drupal 7,8, pantheon
- vanilla html, css, javascript

company.name: City and County of San Francisco

positions.title: Web/Mobile Developer
positions.description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AngularJS, PHP, Ruby, Cordova

company.name: City and County of San Francisco

positions.title: Front End Mobile Web Developer
positions.description: Front end mobile web development for iOS and Android devices using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  Also touched on some node.js/express.js and ruby/sinatra projects.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Create clickable prototypes based on visual designs for customer research sessions
•	Build proof of concepts to illustrate technical feasibility of business-proposed features
•	Lead front-end development effort for new products by making decisions on front-end architecture, layout, and libraries in addition to providing all front-end code (HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
•	Maintain various releases of customer facing products by adding to and modifying existing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
•	Communicate with and assist server-side developers in integrating HTML production code with JSPs
•	Occasionally modify server-side Java files to facilitate front-end development

positions.title: Information Technology Associate
positions.description:
•	Part of a project-based rotational program in areas of the Internet Services Group pertaining to web application development
•	Debugged and repaired unit tests that were failing due to the multitude of changes throughout various phases of a payment services project release
•	Fulfilled various requests from business partners to increase application functionality for a payment services project
•	Researched various solutions and best practices for current web accessibility concerns regarding customer facing products
•	Created a simple knowledge base web application to facilitate logging, updating, and resolving of mobile banking issues
•	Implemented the front-end interface for a social payment online service: https://settleup.wellsfargo.com/login.do

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Project Management Responsibilities
•	Assisted in the implementation of security badge access system for building
•	Acted as liaison between administrators and vendors to ensure that any and all communication is clearly understood by all parties involved in system implementation
•	Clearly communicated all hardware and software issues reported by administrators to appropriate vendors

Database Responsibilities
•	Designed and developed Microsoft Access database, corresponding user interfaces, and output reports to facilitate management of corporate security plans for internal clients (Security Program Office)
•	Interacted weekly with clients to meet daily needs regarding use of database by outlining client workflow
•	Maintained and supported user interface for clients when unknown issues occured and trained clients on any added or updated features to user interface

Website Responsibilities
•	Redesigned intranet website by hand-coding HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in addition to utilizing Macromedia Dreamweaver
•	Exchanged ideas with managers and content owners regarding site aesthetics and the importance of simple navigation
•	Attended weekly meetings to report progress of site development and any known issues

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Earned this competitive internship by going through a rigorous screening process that included interviews, tests, training, and performance reviews. Only thirty internships were offered out of a starting class of over one hundred candidates.
•	Teamed with account managers, QA, and technical support to ensure that online applications were engineered according to client specifications and met the highest company standards in terms of functionality, usability, and data validity
•	Managed the online application development, enhancement, and maintenance processes through the use of proprietary development tools, HTML and ASP
•	Learned the complexities of an online service system, including database support and maintenance.  Improved skills in the areas of project management, multi-tasking, and client satisfaction.
